relevance.rationale: Introduces the dual band-generator Garside structure on B_n with fundamental cycle delta of length n-1 and quadratic-time canonical normal-form stepping.

keyResults.statement: Every n-braid has a unique left-canonical band-generator decomposition W = delta^u A_1...A_k computable in O(|W|^2 n) operations.
keyResults.useForFolio: Supplies dual-Garside band-generator normal forms relevant to QOU's strand-transposition / band vocabulary.
